gates.engineeringDefault: Pin a named immutable ruleset; never select rules from the runtime date.
gates.requiredEvidence: JBA/NBL competition regulations naming the adopted playing-rule edition and exceptions.

gates.engineeringDefault: Represent the FIBA 2024 and FIBA rules effective 2026-10-01 as distinct references.
gates.requiredEvidence: Explicit season/game adoption decision from JBA; latest-by-date is not sufficient.

gates.engineeringDefault: Versioned deterministic policy with no alphabetical or ID-based sporting decision.
gates.requiredEvidence: Approved NBL standings, qualification, playoff, tie-group, deduction, and unresolved-tie rules.

gates.engineeringDefault: Keep played statistics, awarded outcome, standings treatment, and player-statistics treatment separate.
gates.requiredEvidence: Approved forfeit, default, abandonment, annulment, and result-only inclusion policy.

gates.engineeringDefault: Half-open temporal membership intervals with no overlapping eligibility by accident.
gates.requiredEvidence: Eligibility authority, registration deadlines, transfer windows, exceptions, and effective-date rules.

gates.engineeringDefault: Separate submitter/substantive editor from reviewer and certifier.
gates.requiredEvidence: Named authorized certifiers and their competition/season scope.
Approved exception types, actors, reasons, evidence, audit requirements, and expiry/review policy.

gates.engineeringDefault: No individual public name when permission is unknown, especially for minors.
gates.requiredEvidence: Field-level authority for public player and minor names, including revocation handling.

gates.engineeringDefault: No public player photo or permanent download-token URL when permission is unknown.
gates.requiredEvidence: Field-level photo/publicity authority, asset delivery rules, expiry, and revocation handling.

gates.engineeringDefault: No production activation before an isolated staging rehearsal.
gates.requiredEvidence: Named staging owner, environment inventory, access controls, and successful end-to-end rehearsal.

gates.engineeringDefault: No automatic deletion of canonical history, journals, certificates, or correction evidence.
gates.requiredEvidence: Approved retention schedule, backup owner/region/cost, Storage coverage, and successful restore drill.

gates.engineeringDefault: Preserve accepted work and recover by validated restore/replay; never reopen vulnerable legacy access.
gates.requiredEvidence: Approved RPO/RTO, recovery owner, escalation path, and rehearsal result.

gates.engineeringDefault: Ship compatible code disabled, then shadow, stage, and activate through explicit gates.
gates.requiredEvidence: Named release authority, old-client rejection plan, rollback decision owner, and launch sequence.

gates.engineeringDefault: No paid service or capacity commitment is implied by this contract.
gates.requiredEvidence: Named budget owner and approved cost/alert thresholds for storage, functions, public delivery, backup, and monitoring.
